ruleDefinitions.name: Harvesting Of Wifi Credentials Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect the harvesting of wifi credentials using netsh.exe

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*wlan.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ s.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ p.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ k.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\=clear.*")))
